shortDefinition: A collection of documents, data, or information that an AI can search and reference when answering questions.
fullDefinition: A knowledge base in the context of AI is a curated collection of documents, text, data, or structured information that serves as the retrieval source for a RAG system. When an AI assistant is 'connected to your knowledge base', it means it can search this collection before answering. Building a good knowledge base — choosing what to include, how to structure it — is as important as the AI system itself.
examples: A company knowledge base with all internal documentation
A personal knowledge base with research notes and saved articles
